source.citation: Duan, Y., Feng, M., Zhong, X., Shang, R., Huang, L. (2016). Thermodynamic simulation of carbonate cements-water-carbon dioxide equilibrium in sandstone for prediction of precipitation/dissolution of carbonate cements. PLoS ONE 11(12), e0167035.

transcription.from: the published article (open-access PDF from journals.plos.org), Table 4 (p. 6) and Table 6 (p. 8), read on the page text
transcription.note: The values were typed into test/duan2016_reference.jl before this file existed and agree with the article. Table 4 heads its pressure column P(Pa) and prints 1.0 and 1000.0; the test shows that the rows are at 1 bar and 1000 bar, and the column is kept here as printed, without a unit.

equilibrium_constants.location: Table 4, p. 6: K3, the second dissociation of carbonic acid, and K4, water autoprotolysis, by the authors' method (TCM) and by the HKF equation (their ref. [3])

calcite.location: Table 6, p. 8: calcite dissolving to Ca2+ and CO3-2, by the authors' Gibbs-energy integration

notes: Table 6 also gives a burial depth for its last four rows (0, 1.5, 4.0 and 6.0 km); it is not transcribed.
